shortDescription: Download the latest UPSC CSE syllabus and exam pattern for 2026.
content:
The UPSC Civil Services Examination syllabus has three broad stages: Preliminary Examination, Main Examination and Personality Test. Candidates should use the official UPSC notification as the final reference for the applicable year.

Preliminary Examination

  • General Studies Paper I: current events, history, geography, polity and governance, economic and social development, environment and general science.
  • General Studies Paper II (CSAT): comprehension, communication, reasoning, decision making, basic numeracy and data interpretation. This paper is qualifying with the minimum standard prescribed by UPSC.

Both preliminary papers are objective tests. Negative marking and qualifying conditions apply as specified in the notification.

Main Examination

The written stage includes qualifying language papers, Essay, General Studies Papers I to IV and two papers from the candidate's optional subject. The General Studies papers cover Indian heritage and society, governance and international relations, technology and economic development, environment and security, and ethics and aptitude.

Personality Test

Candidates who qualify the written stage are called for the Personality Test. Final merit is prepared from the marks counted under the UPSC scheme. Download the latest syllabus and examination notice only from upsc.gov.in.
